name: Ralph Munoz IV
office: City of Glendora, Member of the City Council, 4th District

items.text: Ralph Munoz IV is an attorney and community volunteer running for the Glendora City Council in the 4th District. He was admitted to the State Bar of California in June 2012 and practices in Azusa.
